findingClass: A replacing source set deleted a child row (first case: a peer_companies row dropped by a document or Chittorgarh peer list) but the row's field_sources records stayed live, so every reader of field_sources (admin provenance view, nightly audits, the walk) read a deleted row as live provenance (#1166 item 3, OD-157).
failThreshold: FAIL when any field_sources row with table_name 'peer_companies' and a non-empty row_key has no peer_companies row of the same ipo_id whose normalized_name equals that row_key. Retired records live in field_sources_retired (OD-157) and are therefore never counted. Reported per IPO by name and slug with each orphan row key and its record count, never as a bare count (signal-ownership.md R1).
unverifiableWhen: Never: both tables are read directly.
note: r_child_provenance_orphan: implemented in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs (checkR_childProvenanceOrphan). Covers peer_companies only; the other keyed child tables (promoters, ipo_intermediaries, ipo_risk_factors, financial_statements, ipo_valuation) are not covered (unmeasured). Rows deleted BEFORE OD-157 shipped left live orphans that this check will report on its first run; they need a repair run (move them to field_sources_retired with reason 'pre-OD-157 deletion'), not yet built.
